question: The Commercial Paper (CP) to be used by corporate houses in India was introduced in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1990**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The commercial paper was** formally** introduced in India on **1st January,1990**.
 
• However, the commercial paper were** first introduced o****n 27th March 1989**.
 
• The commercial paper in India was introduced by **RBI** in the Indian money market.

 
• Commercial paper is the money market instrument in which individuals, non-resident Indians, banks, companies and foreign institutional investors (FII) can invest.
 
• The minimum amount to invest in commercial paper is** 5 Lakh INR**.
 
• They are either in physical or dematerialized form.
 
• There are 4 types of commercial paper i.e. **drafts**, **checks**, **notes **and** certificate of deposit**.
